channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Scaling Indic Pretraining: 2.8 Trillion Tokens and an Open Data Generation Pipeline
item.description: NVIDIA and IIT Madras' AI4Bharat released Nemotron-pretraining-Indic-v1, roughly 2.8 trillion tokens spanning 22 Indian languages plus 12 romanized text sets, alongside an open GPU-accelerated pipeline for data generation and quality checks. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Multi-repo support and other improvements for GitHub Copilot in Slack and Microsoft Teams
item.description: Multi-repo support and other improvements for GitHub Copilot in Slack and Microsoft Teams (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
item.description: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs (OpenAI News)

item.title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
item.description: Google Antigravity's agentic science workbench uses ProtNLM to scan millions of uncharacterized UniProt proteins and, within hours, surfaces antimicrobial peptide candidates predicted active against respiratory infection pathogens, now entering wet-lab validation. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Granite Switch 4.1: Chat, Decisions, and Speech from One Endpoint
item.description: Granite Switch 4.1 packs chat, decision-making and speech recognition into a single hosted endpoint, with 8B and 30B models using nearly the same GPU memory as their base models and its ASR ranking first on OpenASR. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Commerce Ministry and Science and Technology Ministry plan to add 23 AI technologies to the export technology catalogue and seek public comment
item.description: China's commerce and science ministries propose adding 23 AI technologies, covering large models, agents and computing clusters, to a 40-item export-control list, exempting open source and API calls, with comments due November 15.

item.title: Upcoming deprecation of selected GitHub Copilot models in mid-November
item.description: GitHub will deprecate selected Copilot models across Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions on November 16th, 2026, so users must update workflows before the deadline, though Claude Opus 4.8 remains for individual annual subscribers. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Teaching students to think and learn through questions
item.description: Teaching students to think and learn through questions (OpenAI News)

item.title: For Those Who Create. KLING 4.0 Is Now Fully Available. 🎬
item.description: Kling 4.0 is now fully available through kling.ai's refreshed creation interface, adding MCP and CLI access, with upcoming 4K and 1080p 10-bit HDR output plus API access for enterprises and developers.

item.title: AI agents banned by Amazon for online shopping! Musk pushed to the brink: fine, I'll just build my own e-commerce empire and compete
item.description: AI agents banned by Amazon for online shopping! Musk pushed to the brink: fine, I'll just build my own e-commerce empire and compete (AIbase)

item.title: Opus 5.5 fast mode in the Claude Platform is no longer in research preview, and we’ve removed the waitlist!
item.description: Opus 5.5 fast mode on the Claude Platform has exited research preview and dropped its waitlist, offering up to 2.5x faster speeds at $8/$40 per million tokens, now on Microsoft Foundry with Google Cloud support coming soon.

item.title: Muse Spark Is Now an Open-Weights Model
item.description: Meta's Muse Spark Open brings 816B total and 42B active parameters, a 1M-token context window, native image, audio and document input, and safety post-training added since August, targeting coding and agentic workflows under the Muse Model License on Hugging Face.

item.title: Muse Spark Open from @AIatMeta is now available on OpenRouter!
item.description: Meta's Muse Spark Open debuts on OpenRouter as an 816B-parameter, 42B-active open-weight model for agentic coding, with a 1M-token context, native image, video, audio and PDF input, priced at $1.25/$4.25 per million tokens.

item.title: A few big upgrades for Chrome users today! We’re bringing the power of computer use to anyone who uses Chrome.
item.description: ChatGPT now brings computer use to Chrome, letting it view open tabs and summarize information, while a work mode can control tabs to send messages, fill forms, download files and group open tabs.

item.title: Kling 4.0 drops late at night: the author puts its 30-second one-take and omni-reference performance to the test.
item.description: Kling 4.0 launched with 30-second one-shot generation and multi-frame references, after burning tens of thousands of credits the author finds stronger physics and action, recommending 120-credit 720P 20-second Kling 4.0 Flash drafts before 450-credit 1080P 30-second finals.

item.title: Download GitHub Code Quality license usage as a CSV
item.description: Download GitHub Code Quality license usage as a CSV (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Kling 4.0 launches: supports 30-second continuous shots, author tests motion and all-around reference
item.description: Kling 4.0 launches with 30-second one-shot generation and up to 10-frame multi-reference, priced at 450 credits (~16 yuan) for 1080P 30s and 120 credits for 4.0 Flash 720P 20s, as tests cover chases, fights and skating.

item.title: Muse Spark Open by @AIatMeta is now in the Arena. Head to Agent Arena to test it out, scores coming soon!
item.description: Meta's Muse Spark Open has entered Agent Arena for public testing, a 816B-parameter model with 42B active, 1M-token context, native multimodality, and tool access to web search, filesystems and terminals, with scores coming soon.

item.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein
item.description: Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6B-parameter open-weight model handling text-to-image, image editing and multi-reference generation with up to 10 reference images, plus an INT8 version that runs on RTX GPUs with just 8GB of VRAM.

item.title: Denmark's Supreme Court rules that possessing and distributing AI-generated child sexual abuse material can lead to a custodial sentence.
item.description: Denmark's Supreme Court upheld an 18-month prison term for a 31-year-old man who shared over 36,000 AI-generated child abuse images, ruling fictional subjects still fall under the Criminal Code, with 273 buyers identified and 25 arrested.
